overview.match: Nikolas Woods is a teacher at Lakeside Middle School.
overview.text: Nikolas Woods is a teacher at Lakeside Middle School. He holds a bachelor's from Cal State Dominguez Hills and a master's from San Jose State University. His campaign website says he wants streets to be walkable, safe and clean. He also proposes a clear, user-friendly report for residents to understand changes in the city budget.
